question:
Refer to the given letter, number, symbol string and answer the following question.

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W @ 3 K 9 ÷ ŷ 6 M & 4 A α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4 (Right)

If the sequence of the middle eight elements in the given string is reversed, then which of the following will be eighth to the right of the twenty-first element from the right end?
solution:
Given:

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W @ 3 K 9 ÷ ŷ 6 M & 4 A α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4 (Right)

__
 
• **The middle eight elements**

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W @ 3 K **9 ÷ ŷ 6 M & 4 A**__ α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4 (Right)

__
 
• **The middle eight elements in the given string is reversed**

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W @ 3 K **A 4 & M 6 ŷ ÷ 9** α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4 (Right)

 
• **The twenty-first element from the right end**

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W **@** 3 K A 4 & M 6 ŷ ÷ 9 α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4__ (Right)

__
 
• **The eighth to the right of the twenty-first element from the right end.**

(Left) Σ 5 U £ ± 2 W **@** 3 K A 4 & M 6 **ŷ**__ ÷ 9 α 5 G δ 7 B % R Ø 4 (Right)

Hence, “**ŷ**” is the correct answer.
